summary.plain: UCNtau published three more years of data (2020-2022), which alone give 877.94 seconds, and an all-data average neutron lifetime of 877.82 seconds with an uncertainty of about 0.3 seconds.
summary.technical: Runs from 2020-2022: tau_n = 877.94 ± 0.37 s; combined with the earlier data the updated UCNtau lifetime is 877.82 ± 0.22 (stat) +0.20/-0.17 (syst) s, with improved monitor detectors, reduced upscattering corrections and four main UCN detector geometries.

title: Measurement of the Free Neutron Lifetime in a Magneto-Gravitational Trap with In Situ Detection
why_it_matters: The abstract says the goals were to better understand and quantify systematic uncertainties and to improve the statistical precision of the lifetime.
